svg.title: Command latency comparison
svg.desc: : Accessibility snapshot, Umbra CLI: 14, Umbra socket: 0.9, Playwright Chromium: 3.6, Playwright WebKit: 4.4; : Click + DOM update, Umbra CLI: 15, Umbra socket: 1.5, Playwright Chromium: 16, Playwright WebKit: 66; : Fill a React-controlled field, Umbra CLI: 15, Umbra socket: 1.3, Playwright Chromium: 2.1, Playwright WebKit: 3.0; : Eval round trip, Umbra CLI: 12, Umbra socket: 0.2, Playwright Chromium: 0.3, Playwright WebKit: 0.4; : Viewport screenshot to a file, Umbra CLI: 64, Umbra socket: 50, Playwright Chromium: 85, Playwright WebKit: 57; : Warm navigate (local page), Umbra CLI: 27, Umbra socket: 13, Playwright Chromium: 6.5, Playwright WebKit: 13; : 200-image page, Umbra CLI: 175, Umbra socket: 163, Playwright Chromium: 83, Playwright WebKit: 147; : 200-image page, images blocked, Umbra CLI: 42, Umbra socket: 29, Playwright Chromium: 76, Playwright WebKit: 60
